requirement: Ensure Wallet Solutions undergo certification by Conformity Assessment Bodies to verify compliance with security and interoperability requirements.
evidence_quote: Wallet Solutions will be certified by CABs. QTSPs will be audited regularly by CABs. The standards and schemes used by CABs to fulfil their tasks to certify Wallet Solutions are discussed in [Chapter 7](#7-wallet-solution-certification-and-risk-management).

requirement: Establish a structured cooperation framework with Member States and the Commission to exchange best practices and advise on policy initiatives for digital identity wallets.
evidence_quote: The European Digital Identity Cooperation Group... is responsible for: exchange best practices and cooperate with the Commission on emerging policy initiatives in the field of digital identity wallets...
deprecated_reason: The ARF text describes the remit of the European Digital Identity Cooperation Group; it asks nothing of a wallet provider, relying party or other organisation, so it is not a requirement they can meet.
